name: [BRUTUM] Pillar Chase [BETA]
desc:
WELCOME TO PILLAR CHASE!

Pillar Chase is a multiplayer horror game in which 1 or 2 players are a monster, and the rest are thrown into a match as survivors.
Survivors must do their tasks and escape; monsters must kill all players or stop them from escaping.

- ALL CREDITS FOR CHARACTERS CAN BE FOUND UNDER THE INGAME MOVESET/INFORMATION TABS.
